summary: A validator for rich-text editor JSON (ProseMirror/Tiptap shape): checks a document against an allowlist profile and returns the text length and the mention ids.
use_when: a server must validate rich-text editor JSON sent by a client before it saves or renders it
a document may use only permitted formatting: an allowlist of node types, mark types and attributes (a link must be https, say)
a post or comment needs a cap on text length, node count and nesting depth
the users mentioned or tagged in a rich-text body must be collected, for example to notify them
not_for: HTML sanitizing or escaping: it validates the editor's JSON tree, it does not turn it into HTML
enforcing the editor's content model: which node may sit inside which, and leaf rules, are not checked yet
converting a document to Markdown or plain text, or rendering it
